interpretation.mapped_field_proportion: Descriptive proportion of in-scope fields classified direct, derived, or bounded. Ambiguous and unmapped fields remain visible and are excluded from the mapped numerator.
interpretation.critical_fields: A critical field may be bounded if the claim is correspondingly bounded, but it may not remain silently unmapped.
interpretation.manual_audit: Author-side semantic traceability review, not independent expert validation.
interpretation.source_scope: Only P1/P2 have frozen field-level schemas and are quantified in E6. Contract-only authoritative sources are reported separately and are not assigned invented field-coverage percentages.
interpretation.completeness_boundary: Mapping coverage is not ontology/domain completeness.
